 Paul D. Vanderwal, age 85 of Wayne, died peacefully at home on Saturday, October 17, 2026. 
 A veteran of the U.S. Army, Paul retired from Bell Telephone after a career spanning more than 40 years. He was dedicated to serving his fellow man as a community volunteer, earning exempt status as a firefighter with the Pompton Falls Fire Co. #3, and he served for decades on the Wayne Memorial First Aid Squad.
 Paul is survived by his three children; Marlyse Vanderwal, Paul Vanderwal, II, and Alex Vanderwal. He was predeceased by his wife, Melody, in 2019, and by their daughter, Arlette, in 1980.
